scope.en: Authored gross-exterior illustration with HRA-derived dorsum. 70,817 source-exact triangles include all 2,788 papilla triangles; body/ventral join authored and normals recomputed. All 4 provenance partitions remain visible; they are not complete anatomical layers. Whole-mouth failure remains open.
scope.zh: 人工大体外形示意，舌背部分来自 HRA。70,817 个保留源几何三角面包含全部 2,788 个乳头三角面；主体／腹侧连接为人工建模，法线重新计算。4 个来源分区均保持可见，并非完整解剖层。全口腔连续性问题仍未解决。

technical.scope: Specified container, topology, provenance and intersection checks only. 204,316 triangles; one closed oriented component under exact-coordinate merge. No clinical proof.

visual.scope: Reviewer-inspected STATIC authored gross-exterior hybrid only; intended, neutral, underside and tip-section evidence. Not whole-mouth continuity.

anatomy.scope: Qualitative gross exterior reference screening only; no anatomist, patient-specific or clinical validation.

runtime.scope: No browser/consumer interaction or motion validation.

limitations: Not source-exact whole mesh or patient-specific; no clinical validation.
Posterior termination is illustrative; no oral floor/frenulum, internal muscles, vessels, nerves or motion.
Papilla partitions are not removable intact layers: hiding them creates holes.
Native numerical HRA Y-up frame is retained, not registration into another atlas.
